luck_method: Placebo days: each run moves every leg to the same number of random ordinary days (never among the month's last 5 or first 4 trading days), same clock and stop, same account rules.
selection_note: Chosen by the user on 2026-11-22 after reading the validation and placebo results: #1 (first 2 days of the month, 14:00-16:00 ET, skip FOMC, 1% stop), #7 (last 3 + first 3 days, 11:00-15:00 ET, 0.5% stop) and #17 (first 3 days, 11:00-16:00 ET, skip FOMC, 0.25% stop): the validation passers that beat >= 90% of placebo-day runs, one per distinct day set. #6 was set aside as the same trade as #1 without its (almost never hit) stop. Picked after seeing validation, so the holdout is not a blind test of the funnel's output.
lede: One turn-of-month pick, frozen on ES and run unchanged on ES, NQ, RTY, traded together in one $1,000,000 account under fixed deployment rules. Compared with 200 placebo runs (the same trades on random ordinary days, never near the month turn, through the same rules) and with holding all 3 markets equally.
insample_note: In-sample on ES: the pick was chosen from 4,864 versions on ES 2018–2022 and checked on ES 2023–2024. NQ and RTY use the same rules unchanged, but they move closely with ES and trade the same days. The holdout tab is the real check.
holdout_caveat: First holdout test of this combination. ES 2025+ had already been scored for this pick (its final test) and NQ / RTY 2025+ for the unchanged-rules check, so these are not new results per market; this page only adds the shared account. Recorded holdout accesses on these markets before this run: 3.
contracts_note: Micro contracts trade at the same prices as the full contracts. MES, MNQ and M2K have existed only since May 2019, so earlier years are a stand-in for what they would have done.
